title: Colab how-to metadata
description: howto.json sits next to manifest.json in modules/howto-<slug>/. The course player ignores it; scripts/check_repo.py, scripts/build_index.py, scripts/build_site.py and CI read it.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editors.

title.description: Must match manifest.json title and the first lesson's # heading.

tags.description: Lowercase kebab-case tags. Must match manifest.json tags.

status.description: seed: an outline from the recap, nobody has run the steps yet. draft: written up and partly worked through, with untested steps marked. tested: a contributor ran every step end to end, on the date given in the module's Notes. Replaces the old boolean 'tested' field.

contributors.description: Who built the module. One word each: a first name (e.g. Sam) or a GitHub username without the @ (e.g. octocat). No surnames, emails or handles from other sites.

example.description: true only for the format example module. Example modules are hidden on the site, left out of INDEX.md and never published.

recap.description: ISO week of the recap the technique came from, e.g. 2026-W45. recaps/<recap>.md must exist.

issue.description: Number of the GitHub issue this module closes.
